verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬੀਰਾਰਾਧੀ ਮਿਸਟਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਆਨ ਕਹੁ ਖੁਵਾਵਤ ਮੰਗਾਇ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਆਪ ਨਾਹੀ ਖਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise beeraaraadhee misaTaan paan aan kahu khuvaavat ma(n)gai maa(n)gai aap naahee khaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as worshipper of brave (in Sikand Puran 52 Bir's Nandi, Bhirangi, Hanuman, Bhairav, etc. are mentioned) asks for sweet, distributes to all but does not eat any himself.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਸਫਲ ਫਲਤ ਫਲ ਖਾਤ ਨਾਂਹਿ ਪਥਕ ਪਖੇਰੂ ਤੋਰ ਤੋਰ ਲੇ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise dhrum safal falat fal khaat naa(n)h pathak pakheroo tor tor le jaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a tree bears sweet fruits but does not eat them itself. Instead birds, travellers pluck and eat them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤੌ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਨਿਧਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਕਲ ਬਿਧਿ ਹੰਸ ਮਰਜੀਵਾ ਹੇਰਿ ਕਾਢਤ ਸੁਗਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau samu(n)dhr nidh pooran sakal bidh ha(n)s marajeevaa her kaaddat sugaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as ocean is full of all sorts of precious pearls and stones but those who have swan like temperament dives in it and relish them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਸਾਧ ਸੋਭਤ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਹੇਤ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁ ਗਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੫੬੪॥
verses.translit_en: taise nihakaam saadh sobhat sa(n)saar bikhai paraupakaar het su(n)dhar su gaat hai ||564||

en.bdb: Similarly, there are many saints and hermits (who have no self interest and are always ready to do good to others without any gain to themselves) their lives become successful helping others.
